answer: An identity that exists only inside this network is worth what the network says it is. Accredited mine manager certificate with mining inspectorate attestation reaches outside it: a certificate inspectors renew after shaft audits. The yarrow of the proof is that the record predates the reward — years of entries made for taxes, work, or licensing, when nobody was watching. A farm staging a hundred such histories must stage a hundred lives, and the spiral of each life is the rehearsal: every date must agree with every other record. The grove is the phone call to the office named in the file.
